variant_recap.line: Commercial-use Sudoku publishing workflow, not a daily puzzle-solving strip.
variant_recap.short_rule: Commercial-use Sudoku publishing workflow, not a daily puzzle-solving strip.

previous_day_used.story_note: Isla starts from the real customer problem: she wants to make a Sudoku book but does not know where to start. She learns the moving parts, finds the Sapiver Press commercial-use pack, and uses it as a practical file-led starting point.

story_continuity.tomorrow_setup: Tomorrow can show recovery from work pressure or preparation before the next meeting.

campaign_strategy.title: Isla Learns to Publish Puzzle Books
campaign_strategy.funnel: Free puzzle world -> creator problem -> product discovery -> factual proof -> practical next step

content_pillars.label: I did not know where to start
content_pillars.ad_angle: Beginner creator overwhelm; the pack provides structure.

content_pillars.label: What actually goes into a Sudoku book
content_pillars.ad_angle: Puzzles, solutions, variants, difficulty, interiors, covers, licence, and organised files.

content_pillars.label: One book at a time
content_pillars.ad_angle: Choose one variant, one difficulty, and one style per book instead of dumping everything into one paperback.

content_pillars.label: Real files, not fake mockups
content_pillars.ad_angle: Use Vol.001 listing previews and free-sample material as the visual truth; do not invent fake product screenshots.

content_pillars.label: Commercial-use, not get-rich
content_pillars.ad_angle: Avoid income claims, guaranteed approval, or Amazon/KDP affiliation claims.

campaign_strategy.main_message: Want to make a Sudoku book but do not know where to start? Start with structured commercial-use files from Sapiver Press.
campaign_strategy.cta: Start with the files. Build the book from there.

listing.title_from_run_report: Commercial Sudoku Publisher Starter Pack, 900 Puzzles & Solutions, KDP Ready Interiors

core_facts_allowed_in_ads: Useful for Sudoku book and low-content puzzle-book publishing workflows
Designed as a practical starting structure for creators who want to build Sudoku books

copy_positioning.main_angle: Isla wants to publish Sudoku books but does not know where to start; Vol.001 becomes the practical shortcut/source material.
copy_positioning.tone: helpful, practical, non-scammy, creator journey, soft product discovery
preferred_phrases: Start with the files. Build the book from there.
A practical starting point for Sudoku book publishers.
For creators who want to publish puzzle books without building every grid from scratch.

do_not_upload_to_public_repo: Any complete buyer-only pack that would replace the Etsy purchase
visual_use_rules: Use real Vol.001 listing images or free-sample pages as visual truth when available.
Do not invent fake Sudoku interiors, fake covers, fake product screenshots, or fake file contents.
If generated Isla art is used, keep product text as compositor overlay only.
Laptop screens should receive compositor overlays from this manifest, not generated text.
Public repo may contain ad previews and sample visuals only, not the paid delivery ZIP.
